newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Intervention Board details EU sugar sale.
newsitem.headline: German Intervention Board details EU sugar sale.

text.p: A total 35,600 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 39.057 European currency units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at the European Union tender, the German Intervention Board BLE said.
Out of the total, traders in France received 19,600 tonnes, traders in the UK received 5,000, traders in Germany 5,000 and in Denmark 6,000, BLE said of the tender, held each Wednesday.
This week's award bring the cumulative tonnage for export from the 1996/97 crop to 2.530 million tonnes.
This week's result compares with the 11,750 tonnes awarded on July 31, 1996, when the cumulative tonnage totalled 2.536 million tonnes.
Last week, the EU awarded 52,600 tonnes of white sugar at a maximum rebate of 39.60 Ecus per 100 kilos.
